messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager: HOSTED-GEN-REQUEST-ERRORS (SEV-2) — Elevated 5xx rate and timeouts for /v1/generate in us-west-2. Start time ~2026-04-01T09:12:00Z. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/hosted/500-spike \u2014 war room: https://warroom.redwood.ai/r/1773004321

Kendra Lee: I got the page. Jumping into war room now. Who's on infra oncall? @Luke Harris?

Luke Harris: here, oncall for infra. Joining war room. Seeing spike on the proxy and increased queue depth on serving nodes.

Tomas Nguyen: I'm available, can take incident owner if nobody objects. Objective: reduce customer errors and stabilize traffic.

OpsBot: Automatic metrics snapshot attached: 5xx rate 18% -> peak at 20% between 09:12-09:15 UTC; p95 latency up 2.8x; affected route: /v1/generate.

Tomas Nguyen: Taking owner. Immediate plan: 1) limit noisy keys, 2) scale serving pool, 3) adjust cache knobs, 4) post initial status page.

Maya Patel: Customer-ops here. Preliminary impact: about 9 customers experienced failed requests; most are low-volume apps but a few are mobile clients. Will prepare status + proactive note.

Luke Harris: quick checks: GPU nodes reporting normal health, but serving-proxy backlog increased ~4x. KV cache eviction rate spiked.

Tomas Nguyen: logs from proxy (snippet):
```
2026-04-01T09:13:02Z WARN batching: backlog=142 latency_ms=310
2026-04-01T09:13:02Z ERROR kvcache: eviction: keyspace=prefix size=4096 limit=512
```

Kendra Lee: looks like a burst of large batched requests evicting prefix cache. Any sign of a new deployment?

Luke Harris: no deploys around that time in prod. Correlating to partner ingestion spike from 09:11-09:13 UTC.

Tomas Nguyen: scaling pool now (us-west-2-hosted-pool):
```
infractl pools scale --pool us-west-2-hosted-pool --delta +6 --reason "incident 1773004321"
```

Kendra Lee: I'll temporarily apply a soft rate-limit to the suspected partner API key to stop batching at edge:
```
apikeyctl set-quota --key xxxxx-PRTNR --rps 5 --burst 20 --reason "mitigation incident 1773004321"
```

Maya Patel: Draft status page message (for review):
"We are investigating increased error rates for the Hosted Generation API in us-west-2. We are scaling capacity and adjusting runtime cache settings to reduce errors. Some users may experience request failures. Mitigation in progress."

Tomas Nguyen: please add ETA + impacted endpoint to be clearer. Updated draft: "We are investigating increased error rates for /v1/generate in us-west-2 since 09:12 UTC. We are scaling capacity and adjusting cache settings; most requests are recovering. Full update within 30 minutes."

Maya Patel: approved. Posting to status.redwood.ai now (will not include partner identity).

IncidentBot: Status page posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1773004321

Luke Harris: applying runtime cache change to serving-proxies in us-west-2 (increase kv_cache.capacity):
```
runtimectl set --component serving-proxy --kv-cache.capacity 2048 --selector region=us-west-2 --rolling true --reason "incident 1773004321"
```

Tomas Nguyen: good. Also, plan B: enable route fallback to gpt-small-quant if scale doesn't reduce 5xx below 1.5% in 10 minutes. Staging command below.

Tomas Nguyen: stage routing fallback (do not enable yet):
```
routingctl set-fallback --route /v1/generate --target-model gpt-small-quant --policy staged --reason "incident 1773004321"
```

Kendra Lee: collecting sample 503 requests for eval/repro triage. Will tag logs and export a 500-sample.

Kendra Lee: command to tag/export:
```
logctl tag --query "status:5xx AND route:/v1/generate AND region:us-west-2" --tag incident-1773004321
logctl export --tag incident-1773004321 --limit 500 --redact-keys session_token,api_key
```

OpsBot: Metrics update: 5xx reduced from 18% -> 6.5% after scale + rate-limit. p95 latency trending down.

Maya Patel: Customer-ops note (short):
"We experienced elevated error rates for the Hosted Generation API (/v1/generate) in us-west-2 starting at 09:12 UTC. We applied scaling and cache changes; service has largely recovered. We will follow up with a timeline and RCA."

Tomas Nguyen: posting approved. I'll keep war room open until we meet the stabilization target (5xx < 1% and queues normalized). If we do see regression, enable fallback immediately.

Luke Harris: cache change rolled to 3/5 proxies; no new 5xx observed on those nodes. Rolling remaining.

Kendra Lee: export queued. Started sampling.

OpsBot: Incident severity lowered to SEV-3 (observed customer impact limited, mitigation successful).

Tomas Nguyen: handing off monitoring to @Kendra Lee for 20 minutes. I'll draft timeline and start RCA doc.

Kendra Lee: taking watch. I'll keep the war room pinned and will notify if 5xx > 1.5% or backlog > 10 for more than 2 minutes.

Maya Patel: prepping customer followup with timeline + mitigation actions, will post in ~25m once stable.

Tomas Nguyen: postmortem owners: Tomas (lead), Luke (infra analysis), Kendra (logs/export & reproduction), Maya (customer comms). Closing operational actions: partner rate-limit removed after confirmation, autoscale will downscale as normal.

Kendra Lee: small note for the RCA: collect serving-proxy config snapshot and autoscaler event history between 09:00-09:30 UTC. I'll attach to doc.

Tomas Nguyen: thanks team. Keeping thread open for any late regressions. If nothing changes, I'll mark resolved in 1h and start the postmortem doc."
